reranked_evidence.title: AG tells court efforts to stop Ben Gvir from undermining police independence have failed - The Times of Israel
reranked_evidence.snippet: Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara said Monday that legal efforts to prevent National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir from undermining police independence have failed. Baharav-Miara said that Ben Gvir had refused to agree to the final version of the principles document, which, she argued, effectively amounted to “rejecting the principle of the apolitical [nature] of the police and the prohibition on political interference in the police’s use of force against Israeli citizens.”. Baharav-Miara also pointed to Ben Gvir’s defiant declaration on X shortly after the High Court issued its April decision that he would “continue to appoint [police officers] based on who implements [my] policy, as I have done up until this point, and if the attorney general interferes, we’ll blow up the negotiations.”. The court’s April ruling followed a lengthy hearing on petitions, backed by the attorney general, demanding Netanyahu be instructed to fire Ben Gvir over the minister’s repeated alleged violations of a commitment to Baharav-Miara that he would not meddle politically in police work.

reranked_evidence.title: Govt committed to establishing self-respecting nation: State Minister Mir Helal - dailycountrytodaybd.com
reranked_evidence.snippet: State Minister for Land and Chittagong Hill Tracts (CHT) Affairs, Barrister Mir Mohammad Helal Uddin, MP, has emphasized that the current government recognizes the people as the true owners of the country. Speaking as the chief guest at a relief distribution event for flood-affected families in Mahalchhari, Khagrachhari, on Sunday, the State Minister criticized the previous administration. Regarding financial relief for those impacted by the disaster, Barrister Helal stated that the government has directed relevant institutions to waive at least one month of loan installments, including interest, for individuals who have borrowed from NGOs. He further assured that the government is compiling a list of those whose homes were destroyed in the floods and will provide necessary support to assist in their recovery. Following the event, the State Minister held a coordination meeting at the Khagrachhari Circuit House with senior officials, political leaders, and community representatives to discuss the overall situation in the hill district.

reranked_evidence.snippet: # Womble Brings On Affordable Housing Lawyer Sharpe in Leeds. July 22, 2026, 2:48 PM UTC. Richard Sharpe joined Womble Bond Dickinson as a partner in its residential team in Leeds, the firm announced July 20. Sharpe brings more than two decades of experience advising registered providers and other housing sector clients on complex residential development, stock rationalisation, disposals, intra-group transfers and social housing finance matters. He has particular experience acting for registered providers on site acquisitions, disposals and strategic portfolio work, and has specialist expertise in affordable housing securitisation, the firm said. reranked_evidence.title: Nepal, SKorea sign for USD 11.8 mn grant to boost agriculture - The Rising Nepal
reranked_evidence.snippet: Photo: TRN Ghanshyam Upadhyaya, Secretary of the Ministry of Finance and Taeyoung Park, Ambassador of the Republic of Korea to Nepal after signing a MoU on Friday. **By A Staff Reporter, Kathmandu, July 25:** The government of Nepal and the Republic of Korea on Friday signed two Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) worth USD 11.8 million in grant assistance to strengthen agricultural value chains and improve public access to legal information services. Ghanshyam Upadhyaya, Secretary of the Ministry of Finance, government of Nepal and Taeyoung Park, Ambassador of the Republic of Korea to Nepal, have signed the MoU amidst a function at the Ministry of Finance. Implemented in partnership with the Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, the Ministry of Government Legislation of the Republic of Korea, and the Korea Law Information Service, the project will support business process improvements, database development, essential IT infrastructure, and capacity building to enable sustainable system operation by Nepali authorities.

reranked_evidence.snippet: # 4 Greenberg Traurig Attorneys Named to Variety 2026 Music Legal Elite List. Biederman, Steve Plinio, Jess Rosen, and Bobby Rosenbloum were chosen as honorees on *Variety*'*s* 2026 Music Legal Elite list. *Variety's* annual Music Legal Elite list recognizes leading attorneys whose work shapes the music industry, advising clients on high-profile transactions, complex legal issues, and strategic business decisions. "We are honored to once again be recognized among *Variety*'s Music Legal Elite," said Rosenbloum, chair of the firm's Global Entertainment & Media Practice. Rosen, co-chair of the Atlanta Entertainment & Media Practice, is one of the nation's top entertainment attorneys, with more than three decades of experience representing prominent talent in music, film, television, and new media, and brings a distinct perspective as a former professional musician. Consistently recognized by *Billboard*, *The Hollywood Reporter*, *Variety*, and *Best Lawyers in America* as one of the industry's leading dealmakers, he advises many of the world's most successful artists on high-profile recording, touring, publishing, branding, and catalog transactions.
